instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium full shot. In a modern living room, the woman in the blue button-down shirt (R1) stands on the left, gesturing with her hands held low and palms up. Facing her, the man in the light green t-shirt (R2) stands on the right, gesturing with open hands, palms up, looking exasperated. They are locked in an intense discussion, framed by potted plants and a blue painting in the background under bright, natural light.
elements: R1 gestures with her hands held low and palms up while facing R2
R2 gestures with open hands and looks exasperated while facing R1
R1 and R2 are engaged in an intense discussion rather than physical contact
R1 and R2 face each other during the discussion
modern living room with potted plants and a blue painting in the background
